row.notes: Sub-VM vm+0x330: resolves selected handles +0xb48/+0xb88, finds the matching card in +0xd08..+0xd10 (or +0xda8); clears list; if the card's +0x130 value (Vm_Get_NodeValueAsString, FNV-1a lowercase) is one of 6 hashes it is pinned first as 'entry_%I64u' (0x140d2b290, list +0xd28); other cards go to a vector sorted by 0x141b92310 (comparator by vm+0x11d4) and are appended; 0x141af3c80 selects the match or first entry. (lane owner review requested) Better name: Vm_Rebuild_UpgradeCardList (bound record keeps its name).
